call_points.text: We remain on track with our revenue target for the year, with healthy orders in hand and deliveries scheduled for H2FY27.
Gavasad Expansion #3 is progressing as per plan, with commissioning expected in April 2027.
Exports to North America gained momentum following the resolution of earlier tariff-related challenges, offsetting part of the shortfall in Middle East dispatches.
Management targets FY27 revenue of around ₹800 crores with capacity utilization expected to remain high.
Current order book stands at approximately ₹452 crores with strong visibility from renewables and exports.
Q4 margins compressed due to lower high-margin export dispatches and a sharp spike in oil and raw material prices.
The company remains debt-free with cash and cash equivalents of ₹246 crores funding the ongoing capex.

penalties.impact: The Company has received a demand order under Section 74 of the CGST Act, 2017 from the Joint Commissioner, Vadodara-I, as above. The matter arose from audit observations relating to classification, reconciliation of GST returns, reconciliation with financial statements, and certain procedural aspects. Based on its assessment, the Company believes it has a strong case on merits and does not expect any material impact on its financial position. Accordingly, The Company is in the process to challenge the said Order before the First Appellate Authority because it believes the entire demand is erroneous under the relevant provisions of the Act

timeline.summary: ALAY JITENDRA SHAH (Promoter & MD) declared no encumbrance on Shilchar Technologies shares for FY2025-26 under SEBI Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹151.65 Cr, net profit ₹28.39 Cr.
Shilchar Technologies reported FY26 revenue of ₹652 Cr and PAT of ₹158.16 Cr, with ongoing 6,500 MVA capex on track for April 2027.
Shilchar Technologies Limited shared the audio recording of its 05-May-2026 conference call discussing FY/Q4 2025-26 results via its website.
Shilchar Technologies reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹152 Cr and PAT of ₹28 Cr, impacted by Middle East logistics disruptions, and guided FY27 revenue around ₹800 Cr.
Shilchar Technologies received an appellate order setting aside ₹3.18 Cr of a ₹3.19 Cr CGST tax demand.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹192.61 Cr, net profit ₹32.98 Cr.
Shilchar Technologies reported Q2FY27 standalone revenue of ₹192.61 Cr and PAT of ₹32.98 Cr, driven by sequential recovery in exports.
Audio recording of the Conference Call with analysts and investors held on 29th October 2026 is available on the company website.
